content.text: I’m validating the one-field manifest repair against a temporary copy before recommending it. That matters here because a full reset would discard the active fact corpus, while a surgical compatibility repair should retain it.

The safe initialization path is a full in-place rebuild while preserving the existing Brain. Do not run `entire brain reset --force`: this repository already has a 6.1 GB Brain with roughly 6,260 distilled facts.

Current state:

- Entire is enabled; Codex and Gemini hooks are current.
- Brain `v0.1.0-416-g58b0c54e` and Graph are installed.
- `main` currently matches `origin/main`.
- Three untracked paths make the worktree dirty: `.agents/` and two files under `outputs/`.
- The old Brain manifest contains one obsolete field that the new binary rejects.

## 1. Stop writers and make the checkout clean

Stop any running `entire brain watch` process and finish active agent sessions. Then:

```sh
cd ~/Projects/entire.io

entire status --detailed
git status --short
```

Either commit the untracked files if they belong in the repository, or temporarily stash them:

```sh
git stash push --include-untracked \
  -m "pre-brain-init-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"

git fetch --prune origin
git pull --ff-only origin main
git status --short
```

The final `git status --short` should produce no output.

## 2. Reverify the installed components

```sh
entire plugin doctor
entire graph version
entire graph doctor --json
entire brain version
entire brain config show
```

Expected:

- `entire plugin doctor` says all plugins are healthy.
- Graph doctor reports `"no_egress": true`.
- Brain reports `v0.1.0-416-g58b0c54e`.

The global Brain config already exists, so do not rerun `entire brain config init` unless you intentionally want to overwrite it with defaults.

## 3. Back up the existing Brain

There is currently enough disk space for a full 6.1 GB backup.

```sh
brain_dir="$(entire brain path "$PWD")"
brain_state_dir="$HOME/.local/state/entire/repos/gh/entirehq/entire.io"
brain_stamp="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"

brain_data_backup="${brain_dir}.pre-init-${brain_stamp}"
brain_state_backup="${brain_state_dir}.pre-init-${brain_stamp}"

test ! -e "$brain_data_backup"
test ! -e "$brain_state_backup"

cp -a "$brain_dir" "$brain_data_backup"
cp -a "$brain_state_dir" "$brain_state_backup"

du -sh "$brain_dir" "$brain_data_backup"
```

Keep these backups until the refreshed Brain has been verified.

## 4. Repair the one incompatible manifest field

The obsolete field is derived seed-coverage metadata, not a fact or session. I validated this repair against a temporary copy: removing it makes the manifest readable by the new binary.

```sh
brain_manifest_tmp="$(mktemp "$brain_dir/.manifest.repair.XXXXXX")"

jq 'del(.sources.seed.history_coverage.checkpointed_unexported_commits)' \
  "$brain_dir/manifest.json" > "$brain_manifest_tmp"

jq -e '
  (.schema_version == 3) and
  (.sources.seed.history_coverage
    | has("checkpointed_unexported_commits")
    | not)
' "$brain_manifest_tmp" >/dev/null

chmod 600 "$brain_manifest_tmp"
mv "$brain_manifest_tmp" "$brain_dir/manifest.json"
```

Confirm that the manifest now parses:

```sh
entire brain status --json | jq '.brain, .issues'
```

`manifest_state` should now be `current`. An FTS migration warning is expected at this point.

## 5. Migrate the old derived indexes

Preview first:

```sh
entire brain memory migrate --dry-run --json
```

Then perform the migration:

```sh
entire brain memory migrate --json
```

If it is interrupted, resume with:

```sh
entire brain memory migrate --resume --json
```

If any command still reports `memory_state_corrupt`, stop there and preserve the backups—do not reset the Brain.

## 6. Perform the full deterministic refresh

```sh
entire brain refresh --agent none --force
```

This performs the complete sequence:

1. Export retained Entire sessions.
2. Refresh deterministic seed context.
3. Rebuild history and conversation projections.
4. Rebuild document indexes.
5. Generate a fresh committed-state Graph snapshot.
6. Reconcile existing facts.
7. Rebuild the pattern layer.
8. Print final status.

`--agent none` means no hosted-model calls or token spending. Given the repository size—about 2,640 exported sessions and 5.3 GB of session data—expect this step to take a while.

## 7. Verify the initialized Brain

```sh
entire brain status --json --details
entire brain doctor --json
entire brain memory status --json
entire brain memory repair --dry-run --json
entire brain stats --json
entire plugin doctor
```

Check that:

- `manifest_state` is `current`.
- Seed, sessions, history, docs, facts, and semantic sources are present.
- The semantic commit matches:

```sh
git rev-parse HEAD
```

- There are no `memory_state_corrupt` or `memory_migration_required` findings.
- The repair dry-run does not request another rebuild.

Then smoke-test retrieval:

```sh
entire brain overview
entire brain brief "explain the architecture and likely test commands" --json
entire brain search "checkpoint" --json
```

## 8. Build the new entity-history index

This enables questions such as “which checkpoints changed this function?”

For a bounded first pass:

```sh
entire brain entities backfill --json
```

For complete first-parent history:

```sh
entire brain entities backfill --limit 0 --json
```

The complete pass may be lengthy on this repository. Once built, deterministic refreshes keep its tip current.

## 9. Restore the temporarily stashed files

If you used the stash:

```sh
cd ~/Projects/entire.io
git stash pop
git status --short
```

Those untracked files will not be part of the committed-state Brain. If they should be indexed, commit them and rerun the normal refresh. To deliberately index an uncommitted worktree, use the required two-step path:

```sh
entire brain refresh --agent none --worktree
entire brain refresh index --force --worktree
```

Worktree-backed semantic snapshots cannot be exported as bundles.

## 10. Refresh outdated agent hooks

Codex and Gemini are already current. Update the other installed integrations:

```sh
entire agent add claude-code --force
entire agent add opencode --force
entire agent add pi --force

entire status --detailed
git status --short
```

Review and commit any intentional repository configuration changes.

## 11. Connect Brain to Codex through MCP

Merge this into the existing `~/Projects/entire.io/.codex/config.toml`; do not remove its current Chrome DevTools entry:

```toml
[mcp_servers.entire_brain]
command = "entire"
args = ["brain", "mcp"]
cwd = "/Users/thomi/Projects/entire.io"
```

Codex supports project-scoped MCP servers in trusted `.codex/config.toml` files and defines local stdio servers using `[mcp_servers.<name>]`, `command`, `args`, and optional `cwd`. [Official OpenAI Codex MCP documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp?surface=cli)

```sh

```

For clients that consume `.mcp.json`, merge this server alongside the existing entries:

```json
"entire-brain": {
  "command": "entire",
  "args": ["brain", "mcp"]
}
```
